lead_story: The upcoming inflation report is a major driver of market sentiment right now, with the Fed poised to raise interest rates if inflation is high. The report will be released on Wednesday and is expected to have a big impact on the market. The Fed's decision will be crucial in determining the direction of the economy and financial markets.
